name: Тамм
notes:
Тамм, the second accuser at Грог's trial in Kragmir (Session 10 arrest). A clanless dwarf in Гвоздь's pay who kept the keys and the count for a port smuggling store. On the night of Session 10 he and Брок posed as undercover guards and tried to hire Грог for a warehouse job. Грог took the money, refused, and when they ran he threw a hand axe into Тамм's back. The wound closed stiff: Тамм can no longer bend or twist, and moves like a dwarf carrying a plank under his coat.

In court he is the quiet one. He says little, nods at the right moments and backs up every word Брок says. The truth (GM): the pair were opening a smuggling store for Гвоздь in the port, and Тамм does not yet know that Гвоздь's crew died in the warehouse the night before the trial.

In a fight he was always the lookout: he sees trouble first, shoots from the back with a hand crossbow, and saves the sap for anyone who turns away. He counts as one of Гвоздь's bought men for Bought Men.

actions.name: Lights Out
actions.text:
Тамм makes a sap Strike against an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] creature, aiming behind the ear. If the Strike hits, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied] 1 until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned] 1.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned] 2.

actions.name: Corroborate
actions.text:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet that Тамм can hear attempts a Deception check to [[/act lie]]{Lie} or a Diplomacy check to [[/act make-an-impression]]{Make an Impression}

Effect Тамм nods along and fills in a detail at the right moment. The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering check. If Тамм is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] or anyone has already caught him in a lie this scene, he can't use this reaction.

actions.name: Wrecked Back
actions.text: A thrown hand axe left Тамм's back stiff as a board. He is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy] 1. When a melee Strike critically hits him, the old wound tears and he is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned] 1.

actions.name: Lookout's Eye
actions.text: Тамм has kept watch on doors for Гвоздь for years. He gains a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.
